name: Akara (Black-Eyed Pea Fritters)
steps: Soak the dried black-eyed peas, then rub off and rinse away the skins.
Blend the peeled beans with the onion and chilli into a thick batter, adding a little water.
Whisk the batter vigorously to aerate it so the fritters fry up light.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep pan until shimmering.
Drop spoonfuls of batter into the hot oil and fry until golden brown and cooked through.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm.
